contract: 2026-09-05 streaming restore (LMCache server): L1 write reservations run in bounded prefix-ordered windows (--l2-prefetch-l1-reserve-batch-keys=32); out-of-memory degrades to the longest reservable prefix instead of the all-or-nothing abort, while contention still aborts the whole load; retrieve streams H2D per chunk window (--l2-retrieve-window-chunks=16), releasing each window's L1 read locks in stream order, so a large restore never holds the whole prefix in L1. Retrieve completion logs bind request_id; failures log expected vs actual key/token counts at ERROR.
